target_name: Full Sample Cash Innovation Profit Composite
rationale: The expression is a straightforward stack of two already-tested archive legs (cash+R&D-over-assets vs. rollover, plus idiosyncratic decay) whose only genuine innovation is the FFO fallback for missing oancf, so it is close to incremental — but the coverage repair is economically defensible and the three-leg combination has not literally been run, making it worth one confirmatory test rather than a new mechanism.

target_name: Full Sample Cash Profit Less Rollover
rationale: This is the archive's "Cash Plus Research Profit Less Rollover" with a missing-data fill and nothing else, i.e. a robustness/coverage variant of an existing signal rather than a new cross-theme hypothesis, and its stated diagnostic purpose is already served by comparing Signal 1 with the existing gen-7 entries.

target_name: Innovation Profit With Sustained Research Less Rollover
rationale: TS_COUNT(xrd,5) counts non-missing R&D reports, so the added leg is effectively a near-binary "is an R&D-reporting firm" indicator (mass at 0 and 5) standardized cross-sectionally rather than within industry — it prices sector membership, survivorship of five years of data, and disclosure practice, not the "funded commitment persistence" the hypothesis claims, and it therefore does not resolve the COALESCE-conflation concern it was designed to address.

target_name: Innovation Profit Less Rollover Less Funding Risk
rationale: The hierarchical test (supplement rather than replace the general rollover penalty) is a legitimate and well-diagnosed response to the gen-7 alpha loss, but the stated justification is wrong — after WINSOR/ZSCORE the zero-R&D firms receive a common negative z-score, so the extra leg adds a systematic level bonus to non-innovators and partly undoes the numerator's R&D add-back rather than "only refining ordering within the research-intensive part."

This is a genuine internal-consistency correction — the archive leader penalizes unadjusted EBITDA decay while rewarding R&D-inclusive profitability, mechanically punishing firms that step up research — and the comparison cleanly identifies whether the mismatch was an expense-discipline signal or measurement error.

target_name: Innovation Profit Less Chronic Rollover Exposure
rationale: Peak five-year refinancing exposure is a distinct and untested state variable in this archive with a coherent creditor-run rationale, though the operator (single worst year) does not match the "chronic dependence across the cycle" language — a trailing average would test the stated mechanism more faithfully — and it will be highly collinear with the current level leg it replaces.
